refs.purpose: Apply the pinned upstream IWC review command as the primary checklist and procedure, adapting repository terminology without changing policy.
Distinguish a genuine workflow-interface or test-addressing defect from a stylistic preference when a label and a test key disagree.
refs.trigger: When an input, promoted output, collection identifier, or workflow-output label does not agree with the supplied test.

refs.purpose: Recognize corpus-observed shortcuts so a finding cites an observed IWC anti-pattern rather than reviewer taste.
refs.trigger: When a structural choice looks like a shortcut and the finding needs corpus grounding before it is raised as required.

refs.purpose: Judge test labels, durable remote fixtures, creator identifiers, and companion-file naming against current IWC conventions.
refs.trigger: When assessing the submission's test file, test-data references, creator metadata, or release entry.

refs.purpose: Read a supplied ledger's open and surrendered entries into the clearly labeled Foundry context section without treating their absence as an IWC failure.
refs.trigger: When the harness supplied an open-requirements ledger and the review needs to report unresolved intent or surrendered work as Foundry context.
refs.verification: Run the with-foundry-context and without-foundry-context scenarios; confirm the labeled section appears in one, is omitted or explicitly stated absent in the other, and that the IWC checklist verdicts are identical between them.

refs.purpose: Read the supplied workflow summary rather than re-deriving inputs, outputs, tool pins, defaults, connections, labels, and existing tests.

produces.description: Advisory IWC-policy review of one Galaxy workflow pull-request subject, citing structural validation, Planemo test evidence, and optional Foundry context.

consumes.description: The normalized concrete gxformat2 workflow under review, as emitted by [[summarize-galaxy-workflow]]; the reviewed subject in the standard pipeline.
The equivalent concrete gxformat2 workflow when a Foundry run supplies one directly instead of routing through the summarizer.
Structured summary of the reviewed workflow: inputs, outputs, tool ids and versions, defaults, connections, labels, annotations, and existing tests. Read it instead of re-extracting them.
Terminal structural validation handoff from [[validate-galaxy-workflow]]: the command run, its status, and its diagnostics. Cite it; never restate a validation claim this Mold did not receive.
Planemo execution handoff from [[run-workflow-test]], including its honest test-definition-missing and not-run states. Cite its status; never infer a passing test from inspection.
The workflow's test file when one exists; absent when the submission ships no test, which is a reviewable finding rather than an error.
Harness-supplied pull-request context: repository, pull request number, title and body, base and head SHAs, changed-file list, base-to-head diff, and the complete relevant files.
The submission's `.dockstore.yml` when present; it names the primary Galaxy descriptor under the IWC-Lab repository profile, which may be a `.gxwf.yml` file.
Existing structural diff from [[compare-against-iwc-exemplar]] when a Foundry run already produced one. Consume it; never rerun that comparison inside this Mold.
Carried obligations ledger [[open-requirements-ledger]] when a Foundry run supplied one; read-only here, used to report unresolved intent and surrendered work.
